role: The base interface every packet handler implements: the disconnect callback, the connection-state transition hook and the per-tick network tick.
scope_reason: Wire format and connection plumbing: native messages are structs by design (SPEC: messages are structs, not bytes) (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md).

members.name: onDisconnect
members.note: The native session ends by tape length or quit op; no disconnect callback exists.

members.name: onConnectionStateTransition
members.note: No protocol states in the native tick; messages are structs (SPEC 'two sides').

members.name: onNetworkTick
members.note: The network tick's counter and its per-tick decrements live in the native server tick (NetHandlerPlayServer.onNetworkTick's port); the keep-alive and idle-kick parts have no counterpart.

notes: The interface exists only as the dispatch target of the Netty layer the native engine replaces.
